text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I won't say pathetic things 
anymore. Never again.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I promise to this sea! In the Classic 
year's autumn— I will never, ever hang my 
head!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"I will just keep looking forward and 
pushing ahead! Please watch over me!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black presses her lips together 
firmly and stands resolute. Just then...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Is something the matter, Kitasan 
Black-san? You have quite a lovely look on 
your face.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Bakushin O-san. I simply realized 
something important, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin, Bakushin! In the end, this is 
all that matters, right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! You noticed, did you? You bet it 
is!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
March forward without hesitation; go, and 
you shall understand! Now then, everyone 
together—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The way of life of her senpais overlaps as 
one with the Bakushin Spirit she 
inherited. Only relentless, single-minded 
repetition can force open that heavy door.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"This autumn, let us see Kitasan Black 
show off her unshakeable grit."
